title: Circadian dependence of habituation/extinction learning in exposure therapy in patients with anxiety spectrum disorders
summary: Expositionstherapien sind wirksame Standardverfahren zur psychotherapeutischen Behandlung von Angstspektrumsstörungen. Ob die Tageszeit einen Einfluß auf das dabei stattfindende Verlernen von Ängsten hat, wissen wir bislang nicht. Wir untersuchen in dieser Studie, ob die therapeutische Wirkung am Morgen oder am späten Nachmittag stärker ausfällt.

interventions.name:
Exposure sessions 1 and 2 starting at 08:00 h
(Duration of at least 90 minutes, in attendence of a trained therapist, focussing on the same stimulus of at least 50% intensity according to the patient's individual avoidance hierarchy)

Exposure sessions 1 and 2 starting at 16:00 h
(Duration of at least 90 minutes, in attendence of a trained therapist, focussing on the same stimulus of at least 50% intensity according to the patient's individual avoidance hierarchy)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Anxiety disorder, obsessive-compulsive disorder, or post-traumatic stress disorder
Clinical indication for exposure therapy
Exclusion criteria:
Psychotic disorder, organic psychiatric disorder, current drug abuse or dependency, acute suicidality, pregnancy, epilepsy, clinically relevant heart or lung disease
